description:
In a world where heroes and villains live among humans, ACE hero agency and the Olymforce villains are in a constant power struggle. ACE hero Evan (codename Roid), blessed with super strength, is an impenetrable wall of force and power. The only thing that can make him crumble? His roommate Nolan, who he’s been crushing on for over three years. However, everything comes crashing down when Evan nearly catches the elusive teleporting villain Hermes…only to discover that he’s been Nolan all along! Stuck between his unwavering sense of duty and his unrequited love, Evan has a choice to make: turn Nolan in to keep the city safe, or help keep the villain’s identity hidden for a chance at love. With great power comes great responsibility – whether you want it or not! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.*
